content_text:
Hi Roger,
I heard on your wonderful podcast Denis Villeneuve praising your strong ability to design a shot according to the structure of a scene. Can you explain what he is pointing to in more details and share with me your process for accomplishing such alignment.
Also do you have suggestions to develop that ability ?
Thank you very much!
